concerns.text: Tasks T045-T048 are deferred to a future 'Review & Revision' phase triggered by an undefined '/speckit.analyze' pass. This leaves critical safety and integrity requirements (no synthetic fallback, memory limits, runtime safety) unimplemented in the current execution plan, violating the requirement that every spec FR/SC and plan element must have a task in the current plan.

Task T025c enforces a 'fatal error' and 're-plan flag' if convergence rate < 90%. This contradicts the spec's Edge Case handling and SC-002, which require the system to log failures, attempt restarts, and exclude non-converging participants rather than halting the entire project. A task covering the 'exclude and log' logic for non-converging participants is missing.

Task T014 specifies a custom 'scipy.optimize' implementation for motion correction. The Plan and Spec imply standard pipelines (fMRIPrep/nilearn) for 'standard pipelines' and Constitution Principle VI requires documented standard parameters. A task to validate this custom implementation against a standard tool or to replace it with a standard library call is missing.

Task T031 (GLM Analysis) description lacks explicit mention of 'parametric modulation by feedback discrepancy' as a verification condition, creating a traceability gap with FR-003. While T031 exists, its description does not fully cover the specific requirement text.

Task T033 (permutation test) uses ambiguous phrasing 'union of all p-values' for FDR correction. FR-004 and Constitution Principle VI require 'FDR correction across all voxel and region analyses'. A task clarification or rephrasing to ensure 'joint FDR correction' is covered is needed.
